title: Console intent
question: What is this message to the BeTenshi console asking for?

choices.chat: a general question or writing task for a language model
choices.code: write, fix, explain or review code
choices.speech: transcribe audio, speak text aloud, or clone a voice
choices.vision: analyse, segment or read an existing image or photo, or recover a pose
choices.service: start, stop, restart or check a local service, the GPU, memory, or logs
choices.models: choose, compare, install, price or check usage of models

rubric: Classes are the console's own surfaces: Chat (llm), Arena/Models, Qwen image studio, Speech, SAM 3 / SAM 3D, and Services/Stack/Requests. A message that could be done by chat but names a console surface is labelled by the surface.
labeller: Hand-written and hand-labelled by the Claude Opus 5.5 session running brief 05. The console keeps no chat log with message text, and router logs were not read.
